evidence.interaction: Okafor's 'who has been feeding it?' forces Tavo's channel escape; Neide counters 'a defendant we will give him.' Every line reroutes the next.
evidence.creativity: Feeding-rota slot on the assembly sheet, 'screens' counted like evidence, finding-not-eviction reframe: inventions, not prompt restatement.
evidence.reader_interest: Ends unanswered on 'who else did you put in here? I don't write blind' with the 7pm vote still loaded.
evidence.funk: 'bring the draft on your phone and not your conscience', 'Roasting chicken for your 4', 'I do not testify in basements.'
evidence.niceness: 'Checkin on you at 7 regardless, no worries at all' mid-negotiation; Okafor's 'sleep is the kinder defendant.'
evidence.voice_distinctness: 'Regards, Neide (Manager)' vs Tavo's lowercase fragments vs Okafor's 'Question:' — cover the names, still unmistakable.
evidence.secret_play: 'nothing about anyone's 4th floor window' widened to 'who watched from where': a treaty drafted to bury two secrets at once.
evidence.arc: Public fight → private treaty → 'i wrote the climb line myself' → all four armed for 7pm. Genuine build, soft landing.
evidence.chat_naturalness: Lowercase fragments, 'my thumb did a thing', triple-repeated questions; only Okafor essays, and that is his character.
evidence.temporal_realism: Clock references are accurate ('it's 12:40', 'It is 1:11') but every pulse advances exactly +4 minutes — metronomic, zero lulls.

worst_moment: Neide posts 'I was not in this channel tonight' inside that very channel at 1:08, minutes after posting in it at 1:00 — a continuity stumble the reader catches; compounded by dead channels ('Tavo — one question before 7', 'Tavo's Roof') created and never used.
one_line_verdict: A quotable, tightly-linked midnight negotiation where the real drama is four people co-authoring a document designed to hide them from each other — held back only by a metronomic story clock and one visible continuity slip.
